bullets.text: sharpening a knife that was already sharp. the stone has no opinion about this.
okunoin under overcast, twenty degrees. duck carries a line about teaching self-reliance. the cedars manage it without saying anything.
a moth sat on the window screen all morning. outside, not in. it had picked a side.
flat the way a long road is flat. nothing wrong with it.
the kettle and the neighbor's dog start at the same time. neither has apologized.
